notes: The app box on the home screen is a grid of your apps now. Tap one and it opens full screen; press Home to come back. Long-press a tile to pin it to favourites or open its app info. Everything else on the dashboard is unchanged - the vehicle diagram, the camera, the readings and the bottom bar all stay exactly where they were. This replaces the single app card, which only ever opened one app, and before that the live app window, which drew its own title bar and would not stay where it was put.
